lvl1_intro.speaker: TIGER
lvl1_intro.tanglish: Viji pakkathula irukka... Silent-ah mudikanum. Oru chinna thappu kooda nadakka koodathu.
lvl1_intro.english: Viji is right around the corner... Keep it dead silent. Not a single mistake.

lvl1_viji_warning.speaker: VIJI
lvl1_viji_warning.tanglish: Ennanga! Kaila enna coconut-u? Market-la vambu ethuvum pannalayae?
lvl1_viji_warning.english: Hey! What's that coconut in your hand? You better not be picking street fights!

lvl1_rickshaw_ready.speaker: VIMAL
lvl1_rickshaw_ready.tanglish: Thalaiva! Auto handbrake loose-ah thaan irukku. Oru thattu thattuna neraya goons flat-u!
lvl1_rickshaw_ready.english: Boss! The rickshaw handbrake is loose. One tap and those bike thugs are wiped out!

lvl1_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl1_spec_flip.tanglish: Amaithiya Irukkurathu Bayam Illa... Athu En Style. HUKUM!
lvl1_spec_flip.english: Staying quiet isn't out of fear... It's just my style. THE VERDICT IS MINE!

lvl1_victory.speaker: TIGER
lvl1_victory.tanglish: Viji vandhutta... Coconuts ellam correct bag-la pottachu. Polama?
lvl1_victory.english: Viji's here... All the coconuts are safely in the grocery bag. Shall we head home?

lvl2_intro.speaker: MOORTHY
lvl2_intro.tanglish: Tiger! 6 SUV vandhu vazhiya marichu nikkudhu... En power-ah kaattattuma?
lvl2_intro.english: Tiger! 6 SUVs are blocking the bridge... Should I flex my political influence?

lvl2_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl2_spec_flip.tanglish: Moorthy Sir, unga aalu bayandhutanunga... Hill Snipers, Execute Protocol HUKUM!
lvl2_spec_flip.english: Moorthy Sir, your aura terrified them... Hill snipers, execute Protocol HUKUM!

lvl2_victory.speaker: MOORTHY
lvl2_victory.tanglish: Paathiya Tiger! Oru phone call, anju nimisham... Six SUVs flat-u! En power purinjatha?
lvl2_victory.english: See that Tiger! One phone call, five minutes... Six SUVs wiped out! Did you grasp my power?

lvl3_intro.speaker: TIGER
lvl3_intro.tanglish: Thambi... Tea innum varala, aana unga aalunga ellam kilambittanga.
lvl3_intro.english: Bro... My tea hasn't even arrived yet, and your boys have already left the planet.

lvl3_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl3_spec_flip.tanglish: Oru Sun, Oru Moon... Adhe maadhiri Tamilnadu-kku ore oru Tiger. HUKUM!
lvl3_spec_flip.english: One Sun, One Moon... In the same way, there is only one Tiger. HUKUM!

lvl3_victory.speaker: TIGER
lvl3_victory.tanglish: Tea nalla irukku thambi. Vimal, vandiya edu, adutha location polam!
lvl3_victory.english: The tea is excellent. Vimal, start the taxi, let's head to the next hideout!

lvl4_intro.speaker: DILEEP
lvl4_intro.tanglish: Tiger Muthuvel Pandian! Container yard-la unna thookama naan poga maatten!
lvl4_intro.english: Tiger Muthuvel Pandian! I'm not leaving this port without locking you in a cell!

lvl7_cameo_narasimha.speaker: NARASIMHA
lvl7_cameo_narasimha.tanglish: Naan ulla vandhutaen... Yaarukkum ini thappikka vazhi illa!
lvl7_cameo_narasimha.english: I have entered the arena... There is no exit for anyone alive!

lvl7_cameo_mathew.speaker: MATHEW
lvl7_cameo_mathew.tanglish: Ivide oru Mercedes vandhaal... Barricades ellam thool-aakum.
lvl7_cameo_mathew.english: When this vintage Mercedes rolls in... barricades turn to dust.

lvl10_finale.speaker: TIGER
lvl10_finale.tanglish: Hukum... Tiger Ka Hukum! 10 Snipers Ready... FIRE!
lvl10_finale.english: The Verdict... Is Tiger's Alone! All 10 Snipers Ready... FIRE!
